description: Experimental fused-HVP Newton-CG correction with online acceptance and budgeted continuation; no production solver.
limitations: Scratch only: not production-integrated; baseline and continuation timings are in-process and include reconstruction but independent scoring is excluded and separately recorded.

First continuation panel applied a wide progress check to all dimensions and incorrectly labeled narrow rank/shift as nonconverged; v2 uses the matching production criterion and preserves this evidence.
Continuation-panel-v1.py was reconstructed byte-for-byte and checked against its in-run driver hash; all individual JSON files retain in-run source_before/source_after and integrity flags.
Earlier fused_experiment.py used sigmoid(z)-y and p*(1-p), which can lose saturated tails; stable single-case reruns use fused_experiment_stable.py with signed residual and sigmoid(z)*sigmoid(-z).
C=10 and early-start seed83 did not converge under the existing 200 accepted-step budget; rejected corrections or failures remain explicit.
The accurate-reference rows with gradient above 1e-7 or warnings are invalid under the benchmark reference gate and must not be used as tight accuracy claims.
The HVP count is extra inner work, not counted among accepted outer iterations; warmed repeat panel has one warmup and three measurements only.
Scratch uses forced-managed paths on selected controls and has not tested the native sketched bridge, no-intercept, arbitrary rank dependencies, all-zero or zero-weight edge cases.
